answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 3164 Country: India Title: Since the income tax system in india has give relaxation for income invested in mutual fund or others, could you please help me with the investor where i can invest my money to save Income tax. Question: as-salaam alaekum brother since the income tax system in india has give relaxation for income invested in mutual fund or others, could you please help me with the investor where i can invest my money to save Income tax Answer ID: 3164 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 161/156=J) In order to avoid the un-Islamic demand of income tax the Ulama have allowed to invest money in mutual fund which operate on halal business and shun interest - based transactions and dealings. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
